turns.text: Hi, you've reached Copper Wok Harbor. What can I do for you?
I'd like to order the kung pao chicken and the shrimp fried rice and the sesame green beans for delivery please.
One thing: my wife is allergic to gluten. Is that a problem?
Of course. So we're checking for gluten, for your wife, right?
I'm pretty sure the kung pao chicken doesn't have any gluten in it, but you can double check on our site, copperwok.example/allergens.
Happy to. What address should we deliver to?
You're inside our delivery zone. That's kung pao chicken and shrimp fried rice and sesame green beans, $49.50 with the delivery fee. We'll text you when the driver leaves.
Can I get a name and phone number for the order?
